newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades Gateway.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades Gateway.

text.p: --Lehman Brothers analyst Kimberly Alexy said she downgraded Gateway 2000 Inc to outperform from strong buy, partly because of new competetion from Sony and Toshiba in the retail desktop computer market.
--She also tied her decision to downgrade the stock to general projections of a softer fourth quarter for the U.S. personal computer market.

--Alexy said Gateway shares are currently "trading above their historical trading range... they don't have a lot of upside potential." She said she saw Gateway as a "maximum $60 stock given current earnings momentum."
--Gateway shares were trading down 3-7/8 at 51-1/4 on turnover of more than two million shares.
